data.action: 立于水廊柱旁半转身回眸，指尖轻抚珍珠链
data.animaCaption: Pausing along a moonlit marble colonnade above the sea, she glances back over her bare shoulder while trailing her gloved fingers along the pearl chains of her lavender mermaid gown.
data.camera: 全身镜头，三分之二背影回眸
data.description: 海浪轻拍柱基的月夜大理石水廊上，坎特蕾拉身着露背紫罗兰人鱼尾礼服，背对海月回眸轻抚肩头珍珠串链。
data.lighting: 清冷海月银辉与廊柱壁灯暖光
data.location: 翡萨烈临海珍珠大理石回廊
data.promptProse: Along a sea-facing marble colonnade bathed in full moonlight, Cantarella turns her head over a pearl-draped bare shoulder, the train of her lavender satin mermaid dress pooling on the stone floor.
data.title: 坎特蕾拉 · 月夜珍珠回廊回眸轻抚珍珠链
